QuestionStmt.S: The rate of reduction of a person's assets is proportional to the square root of the existing assets. The assets reduced from 25 lakhs to 6.25 lakhs in 2 years. This rate of reduction of his assets will make him bankrupt in

Solution.S:
Let $x$ represent the value of the asset at time $t$ years.

$$\frac{dx}{dt} \propto \sqrt{x}$$

$$\frac{dx}{dt} = -k\sqrt{x}$$

$$\Rightarrow \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x}} = -kdt$$

Integrating on both sides, we get

$$2\sqrt{x} = -kt + c$$

When $t = 0, x = 25$

$$\therefore 2\sqrt{25} = c \Rightarrow c = 10$$

$$\therefore 2\sqrt{x} = -kt + 10 \quad \ldots (i)$$

When $t = 2, x = 6.25$

$$\therefore 2\sqrt{6.25} = -2k + 10 \quad \ldots [\text{From (i)}]$$

$$\Rightarrow 2(2.5) = -2k + 10$$

$$\Rightarrow 5 = -2k + 10$$

$$\Rightarrow 2k = 5$$

$$\Rightarrow k = \frac{5}{2}$$

$$\therefore 2\sqrt{x} = -\frac{5}{2}t + 10 \quad \ldots [\text{From (i)}]$$

Time to go bankrupt = $T$

When $t = T, x = 0$

$$\therefore 0 = -\frac{5}{2}T + 10$$

$$\Rightarrow T = 4 \text{ years}$$
